core_proofs: Finite hidden-action timing, observable versus verifiable outcomes, risk-neutral principal and agent utility u(w)-c(a), initial IR, every-action global IC and wage bounds. Define weak recommendation/participation tie selection and strict-implementation limits. Transform to utility payments v=u(w); inverse h is convex. Prove fixed-target feasible set convex and objective convex, strict uniqueness only when appropriate. A feasible multiplier/tangent certificate is sufficient globally; do not assume universal binding IR or unqualified KKT necessity.

Original wealth-floor risk-neutral contract with a complete global lower-bound/attainability proof and comparison across H,L,no contract. General floor -B and explicitly bounded worker liability; rent, insurance and efficiency distinctions. Do not merely reprint undergraduate example: general utility-space method and wealth-dependent selection are the graduate extension.

Finite sufficient-statistic theorem: positive action-conditional state probabilities; statistic T is sufficient when conditional state laws given T are action independent, equivalently every likelihood ratio relative to target is T-measurable. Prove both directions of factorization and replace each contract by conditional expected utility followed by u inverse. Preserve every action utility/IC/IR and weakly reduce expected wage by convexity; strict risk aversion eliminates ancillary wage variation. No blanket assertion all informative signals strictly improve every constrained model. Prove strict improvement for the original four-state example with global certificate.

Global IC versus first-order conditions: continuous binary-success model with interior stationary minimum, entire inability to induce that interior target, and a changed concave technology where a global completed-square certificate works. State sufficient concavity conditions on p,c and nonnegative wage spread; do not smuggle FOA into finite global IC results.

Full finite-horizon promised-utility recursion for finite actions/signals, positive conditional laws, history-independent primitives, continuous increasing u, bounded wages, additive preferences and no private saving/borrowing or persistent hidden state. Full principal commitment, with optional explicitly modeled worker continuation exit constraints. Define V0(0)=0 and infeasible promises, promise equality, all current action IC using u(w_y)+beta U_y, and continuation feasibility. Prove decomposition in both directions by conditioning/stitching, induction to global continuation IC, and attainment from compact finite wage trees/finite target policies. Initial IR may be slack; maximize over promises above reservation. A scalar promise is not claimed sufficient with hidden wealth/persistent types. Do not represent a principal continuation-profit inequality as enforcing every within-period payment without further proof.

Original two-date wage allocation with first-period hidden action and no second production. Explicit payments consumed on receipt/no saving; beta=delta=1 allowed in finite horizon. Prove branchwise intertemporal cost minimization and exact global IC/IR optimum, then reoptimize when worker can quit before date2 payment for utility3/4. Show aggregate initial IR does not ensure every continuation IR, and that raising the outside option can make initial IR slack. Distinguish court-enforced principal promises from worker exit rights.

Full restricted self-enforcing public-strategy contract in repeated hidden effort: public output and bonus, no persistent private state, both risk-neutral, zero fixed salary and declared success bonus class. Derive worker global effort IC and principal ex-post payment enforcement against credible low-effort/no-bonus fallback; check every public state and payment history. Do not apply perfect-monitoring theorem to hidden effort without argument: given public state, private past actions have no effect on future primitives; bounded discounted tail plus finite last-deviation/DP proves best replies against arbitrary private-history deviations. State PPE-style concept precisely. Characterize bonus interval and patience bound only for this class; no universal optimal-stationarity/minmax/renegotiation-proof/private-monitoring claim.

At least six original substantial worked cases and twelve full solved problems, including exact new transfers, global proof tasks, all IC/IR/commitment constraints, research critique/rubric, teach-back, retention and C10 mechanism/auction bridge.
